IBM is a technology and consulting company developing infrastructure, cloud, artificial intelligence, and quantum computing solutions. The Entry Level Backend Developer will develop and integrate backend systems, APIs, server applications, firmware, and databases for scalable infrastructure offerings. The role also involves Agile development, translating requirements into features, applying software development best practices, and integrating AI into platform solutions.

Responsibilities
As a Developer at IBM, you’ll get to work on the systems that are driving the quantum revolution and the AI era
More specifically, you'll work with client-server architectures, networking protocols, application development and databases to create and configure Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) offerings which power all great things at IBM and it’s clients
We are looking for motivated individuals to work bringing up next generation infrastructure by developing Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) that are clean, well-documented, and easy to use
They will also need to have skillset to work on back-end integration for existing and APIs
Additionally, you will design and code server applications firmware and databases that are reusable, scalable, as well as design and implement large scale systems that enable continuous delivery on-premises and in the cloud
Participate in Agile development cycles: design, code, test and support
Translate product and service requirements into client features
Learn and apply best practices in software development and testing
Utilize AI tools to improve your own development efficiency and productivity
Integrate AI to make our platform-specific solutions easier to use and deploy
